battle.name: 索馬里內戰
battle.brief: 維基戰爭列表所列的索馬里內戰，自1991年起在索馬里爆發，中央政府與地方軍閥及反對派武裝爭奪權力，摩加迪沙與南部地區相繼成為主要交火區域。惠氏步槍（Winchester Model 1873）於1873年投入服役，屬於衝突相關地面武裝使用的早期步槍，可承擔步兵射擊任務。

kit.name: 惠氏步槍
kit.history: 惠氏步槍屬於地面力量中的早期步槍類，配置於基層步兵分隊，負責一般射擊與警戒任務；在索馬里衝突相關武裝中，其定位是個人及小隊層級的基礎槍械。

countries: 索馬里亞內戰的主戰場是索馬里亞，但交戰者並非兩個國家，而是國家解體後彼此競爭的武裝派系。1991年巴雷政府瓦解時，蘇丹武裝部隊先後整批倒向不同首腦；索馬里民族救國委員會所屬聯盟、索馬里民族聯盟、索馬里統一救國會議、索馬里民族運動與索馬里社會民主陣線，先後控制首都、北部和南部。衣索比亞接納索馬里民族運動、索馬里愛國運動及後來的社會民主陣線，提供越境基地與補給，但各派所得支援並不相同，不能簡化成衣索比亞一國與索馬里亞交戰。吉布地容納過渡政府並承接通往索馬里亞的公路運輸，肯亞則控制邊境口岸與空運節點。1992年聯合國索馬里行動由巴基斯坦等國部隊執行任務；1993年10月美國以空中支援及直升機部隊直接介入，1994年3月隨聯盟撤出。外國武器仍經陸路和海路流入，因此聯合國禁運沒有使國內戰鬥停止。
countriesEn: The principal battlefield was Somalia, but the belligerents were not two states; they were armed factions competing after the state disintegrated. As the Barre government collapsed in 1991, units of the Somali armed forces defected in whole formations to different leaders. The factions associated with the Somali National Salvation Council, the Somali National Alliance, the Somali United Salvation Council, the Somali National Movement, and the Somali Social Democratic Front successively controlled the capital, the north, and the south. Ethiopia hosted the Somali National Movement, the Somali Patriotic Movement, and later the SSDF, providing cross-border bases and supplies, although the level of support differed by faction; this cannot be reduced to a single Ethiopian intervention against Somalia. Djibouti hosted the transitional government and the road traffic entering Somalia, while Kenya controlled border crossings and air-transport nodes. UNOSOM was deployed in 1992 with contingents including Pakistan. The United States entered directly with air support and helicopter forces in October 1993 and withdrew with the coalition in March 1994. Foreign weapons nevertheless continued to move inland by road and sea, so the United Nations arms embargo did not stop the fighting.
people: 穆罕默德·西亞德·巴雷不是被單一反對派推翻；北、南兩地軍隊相繼倒戈，使他於1991年5月26日離境。哈桑·阿里·海爾被過渡任命為總理，在吉布地主持一個無法有效控制摩加迪沙的政府。法拉·艾迪德率領哈布爾吉迪爾族系的索馬里民族救國聯盟，以技術車、檢查站和首都南部據點建立軍力；阿里·馬赫迪·穆罕默德率領馬傑爾廷族系的索馬里民族聯盟，控制北部與東北部；阿卜杜拉希·優素福·艾哈邁德則是索馬里統一救國會議的主要首腦。穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉希·哈桑，又稱德雷爾，曾在摩加迪沙北部區與艾迪德交戰。北部還有索馬里民族運動建立索馬里蘭行政機構，衣索比亞境內則有索馬里社會民主陣線。聯盟關係不斷改變：艾迪德曾與反對自己的派系並肩作戰，1996年又進入新政府；1999年總統阿卜杜勒韋利·穆罕默德·阿里任命艾迪德為總理，希望借其武裝對付阿里·馬赫迪與社會民主陣線，卻在2001年1月將他免職。聯合國行動由多方部隊執行；1993年美國行動則由少將加里·沃爾斯基協調，並由中校托馬斯·麥克圖納指揮第160特種作戰航空營。
peopleEn: Mohamed Siad Barre was not overthrown by a single opposition force; military units in both the north and south defected until he left the country on 26 May 1991. Hassan Ali Khaire was appointed prime minister of the transitional government in Djibouti, although that government could not effectively govern Mogadishu. Farrah Aidid led the Habr Gidir-based Somali National Salvation Alliance and built his strength through technicals, checkpoints, and positions in southern Mogadishu. Ali Mahdi Muhammad led the Majeerteen-based Somali National Alliance and controlled the north and northeast. Abdullahi Yusuf Ahmed was the principal leader of the Somali United Salvation Council. Muhammad Abdullahi Hassan, also known as Dheere, fought Aidid for northern Mogadishu. In the north, the Somali National Movement created the Somaliland administration, while the SSDF operated from Ethiopian territory. Alliances repeatedly changed: Aidid fought alongside factions that had previously opposed him and entered the new government in 1996. In 1999 President Abdiweli Mohamed Ali appointed Aidid prime minister to use his armed following against Ali Mahdi and the SSDF, then dismissed him in January 2001. UNOSOM involved contingents from several countries. The American operation of 1993 was coordinated by Major General Gary Volesky, while Lieutenant Colonel Thomas McTurner commanded the 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment.
kits: 1991年索馬里亞政府軍留下的裝備以蘇聯系武器為主，但維修與備件不足，能真正投入作戰的只有殘存T-55主力坦克、BMP-1步兵戰鬥車、BTR-60裝甲運兵車及少量D-30 122公釐牽引榴炮；米格-17F與米格-21F-13機體多已停用，未形成有效的空中支援。各派民兵拆散原有彈藥庫，取得AKM、中製Type 56步槍、PKM通用機槍、DShK 12.7公釐重機槍、RPG-7火箭筒及少量RPG式反裝甲彈，並把可用武器裝上Toyota Land Cruiser 70系列或Hilux皮卡，組成可快速轉向的技術車隊。裝甲車、卡車與機車的燃油、輪胎、蓄電池和底盤零件同樣短缺。聯合國巴基斯坦營主要使用G3自動步槍、PKM與RPG-7，並以輪式裝甲車和卡車護送補給；1993年10月美國投入AH-64A攻擊直升機、UH-60A黑鷹直升機及AC-130A武裝運輸機，攻擊直升機使用30公釐機炮與地獄火導彈。彈藥來源混雜，7.62×39毫米與7.62×51毫米步槍彈不能互相通用，12.7公釐重機槍彈和RPG-7彈藥也需另行籌措；聯合國主要經吉布地至洛亞達公路、空運與蒙加迪沙機場輸送，南方聯盟則利用基斯馬尤至巴伊多阿、阿夫戈耶至蒙加迪沙的補給線。
kitsEn: The equipment inherited by Somalia in 1991 was predominantly Soviet-derived, but maintenance and spare parts were inadequate. The forces actually able to fight included only residual T-55 main battle tanks, BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-60 armored personnel carriers, and a few D-30 122 mm towed howitzers. MiG-17F and MiG-21F-13 airframes were largely grounded and provided no effective air support. The factions broke up the old ammunition depots and acquired AKM rifles, Chinese Type 56 rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, DShK 12.7 mm heavy machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, and limited RPG anti-armor ammunition. They mounted usable weapons on Toyota Land Cruiser 70-series or Hilux pickups to form technicals capable of rapid changes of direction. Fuel, tires, batteries, and chassis parts were equally scarce for armored vehicles, trucks, and motorcycles. The Pakistani UN contingent chiefly used G3 rifles, PKMs, and RPG-7s, while escorting supplies in wheeled carriers and trucks. In October 1993 the United States deployed AH-64A attack helicopters, UH-60A Black Hawk helicopters, and AC-130A gunships; the attack helicopters used 30 mm cannon and Hellfire missiles. Ammunition came from mixed sources. The 7.62×39 mm and 7.62×51 mm rifle cartridges were not interchangeable, while 12.7 mm machine-gun ammunition and RPG-7 projectiles had to be sourced separately. The United Nations supplied the route from Djibouti through Loyada, airlift, and Mogadishu airport, while the southern alliance used the Kismayo–Baidoa–Afgooye–Mogadishu supply axis.
tactics: 1991年5月下旬，首都軍區與北方部隊陸續倒戈。5月26日巴雷離境後，部分T-55、BMP-1和卡車不是被完整編制接收，而是按原建制分別投向索馬里民族救國委員會、艾迪德與阿里·馬赫迪等陣營；裝甲車隊沿公路迅速轉移，步兵則在城市外圍與檢查站重新編組。6月20日，十二個派系在日內瓦組成索馬里民族救國委員會；7月8日，海爾在吉布地成立過渡政府。8月的摩加迪沙戰鬥中，海爾支持的部隊從北側進入，艾迪德的技術車則利用首都街區反覆機動，在道路交叉口以PKM和RPG-7阻斷縱隊。到年底，首都實際上沿南北線分裂，艾迪德控制南部和通往機場、港口的多數道路，阿里·馬赫迪與阿卜杜拉希·優素福的聯盟控制北部，聯邦部隊夾在雙方之間。1992年12月初，北側聯盟沿蒙加迪沙機場北面的主軸推進，一度奪回南部行政區；聯合國索馬里行動部署巴基斯坦營並在雙方之間設置封鎖線，使戰車無法自由追擊技術車。1993年5月2日至4日的蒙加迪沙戰鬥最為直接：北側聯盟把少量仍可運轉的T-55、BMP-1集中成裝甲縱隊，沿政府區與機場道路進攻；艾迪德部隊放棄正面對射，利用狹窄街巷、廢棄車體和制高點，以技術車交叉火力及反裝甲火箭攻擊車隊側面。北側聯軍在彈藥補充和後方補給上較完整，卻因裝甲縱隊深入而遭分割；艾迪德軍缺少重機槍與迫擊砲，卻能快速重組。雙方最終在5月4日同意停火，聯合國部隊佔據若干路口，結果是沒有任何一派取得全城。7月，阿卜杜拉希·優素福的統一救國會議依聯合國安排撤出首都北部；聯軍接著要求艾迪德交出重武器。8月3日，一個聯合國巴基斯坦營分遣隊在南部市區接近一處同時存放援助貨物與武器的倉庫，步兵和裝甲車交火後，聯合國封鎖並占據該區，貨物性質隨後仍引發爭議。10月初，美國先以AC-130A與AH-64A提供火力支援，再由兩架UH-60A搭載作戰人員進入低空。10月3日至4日，兩架黑鷹分別遭地面火力和便攜防空導彈擊中，十八名美軍人員死亡；這次空降沒有奪取艾迪德的核心陣地，反而迫使聯合國面對更強的反對與政治代價。1994年3月31日，美國與第一期聯合國索馬里行動撤出，之後規模較小的第二期行動維持到年底。1995年6月，阿里·馬赫迪的索馬里民族聯盟與社會民主陣線結盟；聯盟由西南和南部兩條路線施壓，先後奪取巴伊多阿與阿夫戈耶，再於1996年3月進入蒙加迪沙。艾迪德部隊因燃料、彈藥和盟軍配合不足而退往南方，這次轉變沒有重演1993年的逐街爭奪。1999年至2001年，新政府與社會民主陣線在南部交戰，艾迪德帶武裝進入首都後又與總統對抗；2001年1月被免職並離開蒙加迪沙，聯盟內部衝突才逐漸收斂。
tacticsEn: In late May 1991, military units in the capital and the north began to defect. After Barre left on 26 May, some T-55 tanks, BMP-1s, and trucks were not absorbed intact by any central authority but moved in their existing formations toward the Somali National Salvation Council, Aidid, Ali Mahdi, and other camps. Armored columns shifted rapidly along the roads, while infantry units reorganized around checkpoints and the outskirts of the city. On 20 June twelve factions formed the Somali National Salvation Council in Geneva, and on 8 July Khaire established the transitional government in Djibouti. During the fighting in Mogadishu in August, Khaire's supporters entered from the north while Aidid's technicals maneuvered repeatedly through the urban districts, blocking advances with PKMs and RPG-7s at road junctions. By the end of the year the capital was effectively divided along a north–south line. Aidid held the southern districts and most approaches to the airport and port, while the Ali Mahdi and Abdullahi Yusuf alliance held the north. Federal forces were caught between them. In early December 1992 the northern alliance advanced along the main road north of Mogadishu airport and briefly recovered the southern administrative districts. UNOSOM deployed a Pakistani contingent and established blocking lines, preventing tanks from freely pursuing technicals. The most direct urban action came from 2 to 4 May 1993. The northern alliance concentrated the few operational T-55s and BMP-1s into armored columns advancing along the government district and airport road. Aidid's forces avoided frontal armored combat, using narrow streets, disabled vehicles, and elevated positions to crossfire with technicals and launch RPGs at the flanks of the columns. The northern alliance had better ammunition and rear supply but extended its armor into areas it could not support. Aidid's troops lacked heavy machine guns and mortars but could re-form quickly. Both sides accepted a ceasefire on 4 May, with UN troops occupying several junctions; neither faction controlled the entire city. In July Abdullahi Yusuf's United Salvation Council withdrew from northern Mogadishu under the UN arrangement. The coalition then demanded that Aidid surrender heavy weapons. On 3 August a Pakistani UN detachment approached a warehouse in southern Mogadishu that contained both relief cargo and weapons. Fighting between infantry and armored vehicles followed, after which the UN sealed and occupied the site, although the nature of the cargo remained disputed. In early October the United States provided fire support with AC-130A gunships and AH-64A helicopters before two UH-60As inserted troops at low altitude. On 3 and 4 October the Black Hawks were struck by ground fire and a man-portable surface-to-air missile, killing eighteen American personnel. The operation did not take Aidid's core positions; instead, it hardened United Nations opposition and increased its political cost. On 31 March 1994 the United States and UNOSOM I withdrew, while a smaller UNOSOM II continued until the end of that year. In June 1995 Ali Mahdi's Somali National Alliance allied with the SSDF. Operating along southwestern and southern routes, the alliance took Baidoa and Afgooye before entering Mogadishu in March 1996. Short of fuel, ammunition, and coordinated support, Aidid's forces withdrew south without repeating the street-by-street struggle of 1993. Between 1999 and 2001 the new government fought the SSDF in the south, while Aidid entered the capital with armed followers and then confronted the president. His dismissal and departure from Mogadishu in January 2001 gradually reduced conflict within the governing alliance.
data: 可核對的主要時間軸為：1991年5月18日，索馬里民族運動在北方控制赫格薩並建立索馬里蘭行政機構；5月26日巴雷離境；6月20日十二個派系在日內瓦成立索馬里民族救國委員會；7月8日海爾在吉布地成立過渡政府。1992年3月31日，聯合國安理會第751號決議授權聯合國索馬里行動並實施武器禁運，首批部隊於4月進入；同年底至翌年初，北側聯盟與艾迪德在蒙加迪沙反覆爭奪南部行政區。1993年5月2日至4日發生第一次主要蒙加迪沙戰役，7月統一救國會議撤出北部，8月3日發生巴基斯坦營倉庫戰鬥，10月3日至4日兩架UH-60A被擊落並造成十八名美軍死亡。1994年3月31日聯盟部隊完成主要撤離，第二期聯合國行動於4月至12月存在。1995年6月索馬里民族聯盟與社會民主陣線結盟，1996年3月聯盟軍進入蒙加迪沙，7月22日以沙里夫·哈桑·謝赫·阿登為主席的過渡全國政府成立。1999年12月艾迪德出任總理，2001年1月被免職；2004年通過過渡憲章，2006年6月阿卜杜拉希·優素福當選總統。補給與推進主要依賴吉布地至洛亞達再入蒙加迪沙的中部走廊、衣索比亞經吉吉加或戈德通往北部的路線，以及基斯馬尤至巴伊多阿、阿夫戈耶至蒙加迪沙的南部走廊。索馬里各方、各聯合國分隊及後續政府軍沒有同一統計口徑，完整戰鬥傷亡總數無法可靠確定，因此除已核實的美軍十八人死亡外，不列未經交叉驗證的傷亡數字。
dataEn: The principal verifiable chronology is as follows: on 18 May 1991 the Somali National Movement controlled Hargeisa in the north and established the Somaliland administration; Barre left the country on 26 May; twelve factions formed the Somali National Salvation Council in Geneva on 20 June; and Khaire established the transitional government in Djibouti on 8 July. On 31 March 1992 United Nations Security Council Resolution 751 authorized UNOSOM and imposed an arms embargo, with the first contingents arriving in April. From late 1992 into early 1993, the northern alliance and Aidid repeatedly contested the southern administrative districts of Mogadishu. The first major Battle of Mogadishu ran from 2 to 4 May 1993; the United Salvation Council withdrew from the north in July; Pakistani troops fought around a warehouse on 3 August; and two UH-60As were shot down on 3 and 4 October, killing eighteen American personnel. The coalition's main withdrawal was completed on 31 March 1994, and UNOSOM II existed from April through December. The Somali National Alliance and the SSDF allied in June 1995. Alliance forces entered Mogadishu in March 1996, and the Transitional National Government, chaired by Sharif Hassan Sheikh Aden, was established on 22 July. Aidid became prime minister in December 1999 and was dismissed in January 2001. A transitional charter was adopted in 2004, and Abdullahi Yusuf was elected president in June 2006. Movement and supply depended principally on the central corridor from Djibouti through Loyada into Mogadishu, routes from Ethiopia through Jijiga or Gode into the north, and the southern corridor from Kismayo through Baidoa and Afgooye to Mogadishu. The Somali factions, separate UN contingents, and the later government forces did not keep compatible casualty records, so no reliable overall combat total can be given. Apart from the verified eighteen American deaths, unverified loss figures are therefore not listed.
cause: 內戰的根源不是1991年5月的一次突然叛變，而是軍事、財政與政治崩潰同時發生。1977年至1978年對衣索比亞的奧加登戰爭、此後維持龐大軍隊的支出、蘇聯援助與石油收入下降，已使巴雷政府缺乏維持單一國家武力的資源。1980年代，索馬里民族救國委員會、索馬里民族運動及其他武裝在國境內外建立網路；北方戰線持續吸收倒戈官兵與裝備，使政府軍的團結逐漸被族群、籍屬與個人利益侵蝕。巴雷以中央集權和軍事菁英排斥其他地區的做法，短期壓低叛亂，長期卻使軍隊沒有可被繼承的合法指揮鏈。1991年政府無法按時發薪、許多裝甲車缺乏燃料與零件，首都與北方部隊於是先後倒戈；北部索馬里民族運動攻取赫格薩及政府軍在摩加迪沙失去控制，則令海爾在吉布地建立的過渡政府只有名義權力。各派之所以迅速轉為內戰，是因為掌握首都即可取得機場、港口、海關收入、外援通道與國際合法性。衣索比亞局勢改變、美軍在1991至1993年間縮減區域援助，以及周邊國家與外部商人持續供應武器，又把原本可能由單一軍隊處理的政治崩潰，變成由多支外來武裝共同爭奪的戰爭。
causeEn: The civil war did not begin with a sudden coup in May 1991; military, fiscal, and political collapse occurred together. The 1977–78 Ogaden War against Ethiopia, the continuing cost of maintaining a large army, declining Soviet assistance, and reduced oil revenue had already deprived the Barre government of the resources needed to sustain a unified national force. During the 1980s the Somali National Salvation Council, the Somali National Movement, and other armed groups established networks inside and outside the country. The northern front continued to absorb defecting personnel and equipment, dividing the army along ethnic, regional, and personal loyalties. Barre's reliance on centralized rule and a narrow military elite suppressed rebellion in the short term but left the armed forces without a legitimate chain of command that could be inherited. In 1991 the government was unable to pay troops on time, while many armored vehicles lacked fuel and spare parts, so units in Mogadishu and the north defected in succession. The seizure of Hargeisa by the Somali National Movement and the government's loss of Mogadishu left Khaire's Djibouti-based transitional administration with authority in name only. The factions turned this into civil war because control of the capital offered access to the airport, port, customs revenue, external aid routes, and international legitimacy. Changes in Ethiopian conditions, the reduction of American regional assistance between 1991 and 1993, and continuing weapons deliveries from neighboring states and external dealers transformed a collapse that might initially have been managed by one military force into a struggle among several externally supplied armed groups.
impact: 最直接的軍事影響是索馬里亞正規軍不再作為一個整體存在。T-55、BMP-1、卡車、機場與軍械庫被不同派系分割接管，原本可集中使用的火力變成沿道路零散部署的技術車、迫擊砲與輕機槍。摩加迪沙的機場道路、港口道路和通往阿夫戈耶、巴伊多阿及基斯馬尤的幹線成為派系界線、關卡和補給線；控制一處道路或一個空港，往往比占領郊區更能維持戰力。聯合國索馬里行動同時肩負援助流通、走廊保護與解除民兵武裝三項任務，這些目標在首都互相衝突。1993年8月的武器庫事件後，解除武裝從政治談判轉為直接軍事包圍，10月美國直升機遭擊落則把聯合國與武裝派的衝突提升為美軍傷亡事件。禁運未能切斷所有外部供應，派系仍取得步槍、火箭筒、機槍、裝甲車與柴油，武器和車輛維修也逐漸本地化。1996年後，中央過渡政府取得首都與主要公路，但無力壟斷全國稅收和軍隊，各派以局部停火、換俘、重新結盟及武裝調度維持地位。這種沒有統一軍令體系的格局延續到2000年代，使政府軍與地方武裝的衝突反覆出現。戰鬥傷亡沒有可靠總表；可以確認的是1993年10月十八名美軍死亡，其他派系與聯盟分隊的損失因紀錄中斷而無法精確彙整。
impactEn: The most direct military effect was the end of the Somali army as an integrated institution. T-55 tanks, BMP-1s, trucks, airfields, and arsenals were divided among factions. Firepower once capable of concentrated use was dispersed into technicals, mortars, and light machine guns positioned along roads. The airport road, the port road, and the main routes toward Afgooye, Baidoa, and Kismayo became factional boundaries, checkpoints, and supply lines. Controlling a road or an airfield often mattered more to combat power than holding the countryside. UNOSOM was simultaneously responsible for moving relief, protecting corridors, and disarming militias, objectives that conflicted with one another in Mogadishu. After the August 1993 warehouse confrontation, disarmament shifted from political negotiation to direct military encirclement. The loss of American helicopters in October turned the conflict between the United Nations and the militias into an engagement with direct American military casualties. The embargo failed to halt every external supply route, and the factions continued to obtain rifles, rocket launchers, machine guns, armored vehicles, and diesel fuel. Weapons and vehicle maintenance also became increasingly local. After 1996 the transitional government secured the capital and major roads but could not monopolize national revenue or the armed forces; local ceasefires, prisoner exchanges, realigned alliances, and troop transfers preserved the position of each armed organization. The absence of a unified command structure continued into the 2000s and repeatedly produced fighting between government forces and regional armed groups. No reliable overall combat casualty total exists. Eighteen American deaths in October 1993 are confirmed, while losses suffered by the Somali factions and other coalition contingents cannot be precisely aggregated because the records are incomplete.
result: 1991年的索馬里亞內戰沒有一次能終結所有派系的會戰。1993年5月2日至4日的蒙加迪沙戰鬥以停火和南北分界收場；北側聯盟未能消滅艾迪德，聯合國也無法迫使他完整交出武器。7月統一救國會議退出首都後，聯合國對南方陣地的政策轉向更強硬包圍；8月倉庫戰鬥、10月美國黑鷹直升機被擊落，以及聯盟內部對軍事介入的分歧，使第一期聯合國索馬里行動於1994年3月撤出，第二期行動到年底也未能建立有效解除武裝的秩序。這是聯盟干預的軍事失敗，卻不是艾迪德對索馬里亞的全國控制：北有索馬里民族運動建立的索馬里蘭行政機構，東有阿里·馬赫迪的網路，西有社會民主陣線，首都周邊又有其技術車與檢查站。真正的權力轉移發生在1995年至1996年。索馬里民族聯盟與社會民主陣線於1995年6月結盟，利用索馬里民族聯盟在南方公路上的推進和社會民主陣線在西部方向的壓力，使艾迪德失去巴伊多阿、阿夫戈耶及蒙加迪沙南部的支撐。1996年3月聯盟軍進入首都，7月22日成立過渡全國政府，艾迪德的武裝退回南摩加迪沙及鄰近地區。過渡政府的成立沒有終止內戰。艾迪德進入政府後於1997年離開，組織索馬里拯救政府，與過渡政府及社會民主陣線反覆交戰；1999年他被任命為總理並帶武裝進入首都，2001年1月遭免職後又拒絕交出權力。5月的亞的斯亞貝巴安排未能約束所有派系，2004年的過渡憲章與2006年的總統選舉只把部分軍閥納入聯邦制度，沒有解散地方武裝。因而，這場戰爭最合理的結局不是一個有明確日期的全面停火，而是三項可觀察結果：索馬里亞常備軍解體、首都先後由聯盟過渡政府與武裝聯盟控制，以及聯合國解除武裝任務失敗。1993年十八名美軍死亡是外國作戰死亡中可精確核實的一項；索馬里亞各方完整損失至今沒有足以支持單一總數的紀錄。
resultEn: No single battle in the Somali Civil War that began in 1991 eliminated all factions. The fighting in Mogadishu from 2 to 4 May 1993 ended with a ceasefire and a north–south division. The northern alliance failed to destroy Aidid, and the United Nations could not compel him to surrender all his weapons. After the United Salvation Council withdrew from the capital in July, United Nations policy toward the southern position became more confrontational. The August warehouse fight, the loss of American Black Hawks in October, and disagreements within the coalition over military intervention contributed to the withdrawal of UNOSOM I in March 1994. UNOSOM II lasted until the end of the year without establishing an effective disarmament order. This was a military failure for the intervention, but not national control by Aidid: the north was governed by the Somaliland administration created by the Somali National Movement, Ali Mahdi's network remained in the east, the SSDF held positions in the west, and Aidid still controlled technicals and checkpoints around Mogadishu. The decisive transfer of power came in 1995–1996. The Somali National Alliance and the SSDF allied in June 1995, combining the former's advance along the southern roads with the latter's pressure from the west. Aidid lost Baidoa, Afgooye, and his support around southern Mogadishu. Alliance forces entered the capital in March 1996, and the Transitional National Government was established on 22 July, while Aidid's fighters withdrew to southern Mogadishu and adjacent areas. Establishing that government did not end the war. Aidid entered the administration, left in 1997, organized the Somali Salvation Regime, and repeatedly fought the transitional government and the SSDF. Appointed prime minister in 1999, he entered the capital with armed followers and refused to surrender power after his dismissal in January 2001. The May arrangements in Addis Ababa did not bind every faction, while the 2004 transitional charter and the 2006 presidential election incorporated only part of the military elite into federal institutions and left regional forces intact. The most defensible conclusion is therefore not a comprehensive armistice on a definite date, but three observable outcomes: the dissolution of the national army as an integrated force, alternating control of the capital by transitional and factional coalitions, and the failure of United Nations disarmament efforts. The eighteen American deaths in October 1993 are the precisely verified component of foreign military losses; the surviving records do not support a defensible single total for all Somali combatants.
